steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said Eagers Automotive managed major car dealerships, including Audi, BMW and Porsche, and described it as a very well run business with a long history and strong management.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Ben Rundle - Catapult, Dominos, Guzman y Gomez and more

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In August 2024, a guest on Equity Mates argued recent near-record new car deliveries showed supply had normalised and COVID-era waitlists were being fulfilled, while consumer spending had slowed, creating a perfect storm that could pressure volumes and profitability for Eagers Automotive.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Ben Rundle - Catapult, Dominos, Guzman y Gomez and more
